title: macOS mobile development cleanup (iOS/Android/Flutter/React Native and related toolchains)
scope_note: Beyond already-covered primary rules: Xcode DerivedData, iOS DeviceSupport, Archives, CoreSimulator Caches/Logs. Those roots may appear here only as adjacent subpaths or explicit expansions (watchOS/tvOS/visionOS DeviceSupport, ModuleCache, Products, devices, runtimes). Prefer simctl/sdkmanager for device/runtime lifecycle; never bulk-delete whole SDK or AVD config trees by default.

rules.label: watchOS/tvOS/visionOS/macOS DeviceSupport symbols
rules.notes: Same class as iOS DeviceSupport (already covered): per-OS-version symbol packs regenerated when a device of that version reconnects. Prefer deleting only stale version folders, not the parent tree blindly on active device fleets.

rules.label: Xcode iOS/watchOS/tvOS device logs
rules.notes: On-device console logs captured by Xcode. Regenerable; useful for crash triage until exported elsewhere.

rules.label: Xcode Products build outputs
rules.notes: Alternate/legacy build products location (also often under DerivedData). Forces rebuild; default off.

rules.label: Xcode ModuleCache / SymbolCache / CompilationCache (DerivedData subtrees)
rules.notes: Shared clang module and compilation caches under DerivedData. Already-covered root is whole DerivedData; these are finer-grained reclaim targets when full wipe is undesired. Rebuild cost high on next compile.

rules.label: Xcode UserData IB Support, Previews, editor history
rules.notes: Interface Builder caches, SwiftUI preview data, editor interactivity history, local Xcode Cloud leftovers. Do NOT wipe whole UserData (KeyBindings, CodeSnippets, FontAndColorThemes, IDEPreferences).

rules.label: Xcode and Instruments app caches
rules.notes: IDE-level caches under Library/Caches. Safe; may slow first Xcode launch/index after wipe.

rules.label: Instruments traces and saved packages
rules.notes: Saved .trace sessions can be large and user-created; treat as medium. Prefer age-gated contents delete. Do not remove Instruments templates the user installed intentionally without review.

rules.label: DVTDownloads / Available Runtimes leftover downloads
rules.notes: Incomplete or leftover simulator runtime downloads/images. Prefer xcodebuild -downloadPlatform / Xcode Settings > Platforms and simctl runtime delete for installed runtimes. System runtimes also under /Library/Developer/CoreSimulator (report-only rule).

rules.label: System CoreSimulator runtimes and volumes (report-only)
rules.notes: System-wide simulator runtimes (multi-GB each). Never auto-delete; reclaim via xcrun simctl runtime delete or Xcode Platforms UI. Report size only.

rules.label: CoreSimulator device data (careful / report-or-medium)
rules.notes: Per-device UUID trees hold app data, keychains for sims, and large media. Prefer xcrun simctl delete unavailable / erase. Auto-wiping Devices breaks booted sims and local test state. XCTestDevices holds XCTest runner device data. Temp is safer medium reclaim if aged.

rules.label: Provisioning profiles (report-only)
rules.notes: Required for code signing. Xcode/Apple Developer Portal re-download, but wiping causes signing failures until refreshed. Report size and age only; never default clean.

rules.label: dSYMs and archive symbolication artifacts (report-only)
rules.notes: Archives already primary report-only. dSYMs inside .xcarchive are needed for crash symbolication and App Store/TestFlight. DeviceSupport Symbols also used for symbolication. Measure only unless user confirms Organizer delete.

rules.label: Xcode/Shared documentation cache
rules.notes: Offline docsets and indexes; re-download via Xcode documentation downloads.

rules.label: CocoaPods caches
rules.notes: pod cache; regenerable via pod install. Prefer pod cache clean --all when pods CLI available.

rules.label: CocoaPods specs repos (report-only / medium)
rules.notes: Large git/CDN specs mirrors. CDN trunk is default now; old master clone can be multi-GB. Report; deleting forces slow pod repo update.

rules.label: Carthage global cache and Build leftovers
rules.notes: Global CarthageKit cache. Project-local Carthage/Build and Carthage/Checkouts are not global roots (project walk, higher risk).

rules.label: SwiftPM repositories and artifacts cache
rules.notes: SPM clone/binary artifact cache. Re-fetched on resolve. SourcePackages under project or DerivedData is separate.

rules.label: Android SDK temp, downloads, and emulator side caches
rules.notes: Partial SDK downloads and emulator qemu leftovers. Never delete whole sdk/, platform-tools/, licenses/, or cmdline-tools/.

rules.label: Android SDK system-images / NDK / old build-tools (report-only)
rules.notes: Multi-GB API-level images and NDK side-by-side installs. Prefer sdkmanager --uninstall for unused packages. Report only; wrong delete breaks emulators and CI images.

rules.label: Android ~/.android cache, metrics, build-cache
rules.notes: Safe regenerable caches. Do not delete adbkey, adbkey.pub, or debug.keystore (device auth / debug signing).

rules.label: Android AVD snapshots and emulator disk overlays
rules.notes: Snapshots and qcow2 overlays are large. AVD definitions (.ini + config.ini + userdata) should not be bulk-wiped (platforms never_touch lists full avd tree). Prefer snapshot-only globs; whole avd wipe is report-only elsewhere.

rules.label: Android AVD full tree (report-only)
rules.notes: Full AVD data dirs. never_touch for auto-clean in product policy; report size. Use avdmanager delete avd -n NAME.

rules.label: Gradle caches for Android builds
rules.notes: Gradle User Home. Safe but forces large re-downloads. Project-level .gradle/ and build/ are separate higher-risk project walks. Keep wrapper scripts outside dists.

rules.label: Android Studio caches and logs
rules.notes: JetBrains-based Android Studio system caches. Versioned dirs (AndroidStudio2024.1 etc.). Prefer Invalidate Caches from IDE when possible. Do not wipe whole Application Support options/config (keymaps, projects list).

rules.label: IntelliJ IDEA Android/Kotlin plugin caches
rules.notes: IntelliJ caches used when developing Android/KMP outside Android Studio. Contents-only under versioned product dirs.

rules.label: Flutter pub cache and Dart tool caches
rules.notes: dart pub / flutter pub system cache. flutter pub cache repair regenerates. Do not delete Flutter SDK checkout itself (FVM/asdf/mise installs are separate report-only).

rules.label: Flutter SDK bin/cache and FVM versions (report-only)
rules.notes: Flutter engine artifacts under SDK bin/cache and FVM multi-version installs. Path varies; report only. flutter doctor --android-licenses / flutter precache refill.

rules.label: Expo CLI caches
rules.notes: Expo Go caches, native module and template caches. npx expo start --clear for project metro; these are global home caches.

rules.label: Metro / React Native packager temp caches
rules.notes: Metro transform caches often live under os.tmpdir(). Age-gated globs under TMPDIR only; do not wipe entire TMPDIR. Legacy ~/.rncache and metro home caches included.

rules.label: fastlane cache and logs
rules.notes: Spaceship/session caches and logs. Do not delete Appfile/Fastfile (project). Credentials in keychain or env stay untouched.

rules.label: TestFlight / Transporter / AMP delivery leftovers
rules.notes: Apple Transporter upload caches and App Store Connect delivery leftovers. Not App Store app purchase data.

rules.label: Apple Configurator caches and logs
rules.notes: MDM/device imaging tool caches. Group container may hold IPSW/assets; medium risk; age-gate. Never wipe supervised device records without user intent.

rules.label: ios-deploy / libimobiledevice / lockdown leftovers
rules.notes: CLI device tooling caches/logs. System /var/db/lockdown pairing records are report-only (separate) and affect trust with physical devices.

rules.label: usbmuxd lockdown pairing records (report-only)
rules.notes: Device trust/pairing. Deleting forces re-Trust on every cable connect. Report only.

rules.label: scrcpy caches and config leftovers
rules.notes: Android screen-mirroring tool. Config is small; caches regenerable.

rules.label: Kotlin/Native and KMP Konan caches
rules.notes: Kotlin/Native compiler distribution and dependency caches for KMP. Large re-download after wipe. Gradle kotlin caches also under ~/.gradle/caches.

rules.label: MAUI / Xamarin caches
rules.notes: Xamarin/MAUI build download caches. NuGet package globs are coarse; prefer report if unsure. Do not wipe all of ~/.nuget/packages blindly in default product policy.

rules.label: Appium drivers and cache
rules.notes: Appium 2 drivers/plugins under ~/.appium. Reinstall via appium driver install. Medium: may remove installed drivers.

rules.label: Detox global artifacts and cache
rules.notes: Detox E2E global caches/artifacts. Project detox artifacts folders are project-local.

rules.label: Maestro mobile E2E caches and test cloud leftovers
rules.notes: Maestro CLI flows store screenshots/logs under ~/.maestro/tests. Safe to prune aged test output.

rules.label: Buck/Bazel caches used by some RN/Android monorepos
rules.notes: Optional monorepo build systems. Medium re-download/recompile cost.

rules.label: Common RN native module download caches
rules.notes: Occasional global caches from native SDKs pulled into mobile apps. Low risk if present; many installs never create these.

rules.label: Watchman / Flow state (RN adjacent)
rules.notes: Watchman cookie/state and caches; Flow typed libs. Prefer watchman watch-del-all over deleting LaunchAgents plists.

rules.label: Expo EAS CLI and build caches
rules.notes: EAS CLI local caches. Credentials stay in Expo account/keychain.

rules.label: Flipper / Reactotron / RN debug tool caches
rules.notes: Deprecated Flipper and Reactotron desktop debug tools.

rules.label: Simulator screenshots, recordings, and media leftovers
rules.notes: Scoped globs inside Devices only for media/caches/tmp. Safer than full device wipe. CoreSimulator logs already primary-covered; included as path parent for globs.

rules.label: Xcode Metal/GPU tools intermediate data
rules.notes: GPU capture/Metal tooling and IB simulator device caches.

rules.label: CocoaPods-related Ruby gem caches (user)
rules.notes: User gem caches often used for CocoaPods. Do not delete system Ruby or brew ruby prefixes. Project vendor/bundle is project-local.

never_touch_reminders: Project-local ios/Pods, android/.gradle, android/app/build, node_modules, .expo project dir
implementation_notes: Expand AndroidStudio* and JetBrains version globs at scan time to concrete versioned directories.
TMPDIR metro globs must be contents-only with min_age and must not delete the TMPDIR root.
CoreSimulator Devices: default report_only; optional future policy for simctl-driven unavailable-device cleanup.
Count path strings literally including globs and env variants ($ANDROID_HOME) as distinct catalog entries; runtime de-dupe when env maps to same absolute path.
Exclude primary already-covered roots from default enabled packs; expansions here are opt-in medium/report.
